Greenbrier schedules fourth quarter fiscal 2026 earnings release and conference call


LAKE OSWEGO, Ore.


, Oct. 12, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- The Greenbrier Companies, Inc. (NYSE:GBX) announced today it will be reporting its fourth quarter 2026 results after market on Monday, October 26, 2026. Shareholders and other interested parties are invited to listen to its financial results conference call at 2:00 p.m. PDT, live, via webcast or dial-in.


Listeners can access the webcast and earnings release at the Greenbrier website,[www.gbrx.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4793960-1&h=1785794590&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gbrx.com&a=www.gbrx.com) . To register for or access the webcast, click on the announcement shown on the home page of the website. The webcast will be archived for 30 days.


Alternatively, dial-in numbers for the conference call are **1-888-317-6003** for domestic callers and **1-412-317-6061** for international callers; the passcode is "5771220". Please call in 10-15 minutes ahead of time to ensure proper connection.


**About Greenbrier**


Greenbrier, headquartered in Lake Oswego, Oregon, is a leading international supplier of equipment and services to global freight transportation markets. Through its wholly-owned subsidiaries and joint ventures, Greenbrier designs, builds and markets freight railcars in North America, Europe and Brazil. We are a leading provider of freight railcar wheel services, parts, maintenance and retrofitting services in North America through our maintenance services business unit. Greenbrier owns a lease fleet of approximately 20,600 railcars that originate primarily from Greenbrier's manufacturing operations. Greenbrier offers railcar management, regulatory compliance services and leasing services to railroads and other railcar owners in North America. Learn more about Greenbrier at[www.gbrx.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4793960-1&h=1785794590&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gbrx.com&a=www.gbrx.com) .
